title: The three calibrations are the three cohomological data of H¹(Bring)
html:
Bring's curve has first cohomology

  H^1 = 2W, \qquad \mathrm{rank}\,H^1 = 8, \qquad \dim_{\mathbb{C}} W = 4,

two copies of the irreducible 4-dimensional S_5 representation W (A fixed-depth recurrence for the prolonged periods exists (Cayley–Hamilton)). It is conjectured that applying the archimedean realisation \tau leaves exactly three real degrees of freedom in its polarised Hodge structure:

cohomological datum calibration channel
scale of the rank-2 W-Hodge plane = a_D^{(e)} CAL-1 m_e (CAL-1 (m_e) is the n=0 base period of the prolongation tower) h^0 prefactor
modulus of that plane = SL_2 trace \tau = 2\cosh\theta CAL-2 q_0 (Symplectic prolongation (det B = 1) gives a one-parameter recurrence) cosh / bar-even
scale of the \mathrm{Vol}(\mathrm{Hopf})=0 meson sector CAL-3 m_\pi orthogonal class

The rank-2 W-Hodge plane carries a scale and a modulus. The meson sector, having no geometric scale derivable from (m_e, q_0) due to its zero hyperbolic volume, contributes an orthogonal scale. The count 2 + 1 = 3 matches the three calibrations. These form the choice of units forced at the substrate-to-archimedean wall.
